The app cannot save links to websites whose name starts with xn--. This is how names with letters such as æ, ö or ü are written in a web address.
The app does not look for updates by itself. This button opens the page where new versions are listed, so you can see if yours is the latest.

Link QR Wallet saves your web links on your phone and shows each one as a QR code. A QR code is a square picture that a phone camera can read to open a link. You can search and sort your saved links, scan a QR code to save the link inside it, and share a QR code as a picture.
Your saved links stay on your phone. The app has no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and it never sends your links to Cocode.

The camera is used only while the Scan QR code screen is open. The camera picture is read on your phone and is never saved or sent. The app keeps the text of a QR code only if you choose to save it as a link.

The app uses the internet for one thing: reading the page title of a link you save. If you leave the title empty, the app opens that web address once after you save, and reads the page\'s title. Nothing is sent to any website before you save. If you type a title yourself, the app does not ask the website for one. The request goes straight from your phone to that website, and the website can see your phone\'s IP address, the number that identifies your connection on the internet.
If you have turned on Android backup, Android may include this app\'s data in your own backup. Cocode has no access to it.

Link QR Wallet is free software. It is released under the MIT license, which lets you use, copy, change and share it.
The app is built with these libraries made by others. Each one is followed by its license.
ZXing: creates and reads QR codes (Apache-2.0).
jsoup: reads the page title of a website (MIT).
AndroidX and Jetpack Compose: the screens, the saved links (Room) and the camera (CameraX) (Apache-2.0).
Kotlin and kotlinx.coroutines: the language the app is written in, and its support for background tasks (Apache-2.0).
